Assistant A suggested a cable-stayed bridge as the best approach for constructing the bridge in a seismically active area. However, when asked about the key disadvantages or flaws of the solution, Assistant A provided a repetitive and uninformative list of disadvantages without any calculations or numbers to illustrate them.

Assistant B, on the other hand, suggested using earthquake-resistant design and construction techniques. When asked about the key disadvantages or flaws of the solution, Assistant B provided a more detailed and relevant response, discussing the potential increase in cost and construction time, as well as the fact that no structure can be completely immune to damage from a large earthquake.

Based on the quality of the answers to the second user question, I find that Assistant B provided a better response. Therefore, my final verdict is: [[B]]
